create_polynomial_cost_model: create a PolynomialComputationalCostModel with custom coefficients to estimate tensor computational cost
create_aligned_memory_cost_model: create an AlignedMemoryCostModel with custom alignment bytes to estimate tensor memory cost
compute_tensor_cost_polynomial: compute the polynomial computational cost of a PyTorch tensor using PolynomialComputationalCostModel
compute_tensor_cost_memory: compute the aligned memory cost of a PyTorch tensor using AlignedMemoryCostModel
use_default_cost_model: use the DefaultCostModel singleton to compute aligned memory cost for a tensor
